gloss: one night and two days; overnight trip

definitions.gloss: one night and two days; overnight trip
definitions.explanation: A trip or stay lasting one night and spanning two calendar days. The standard way to describe a short overnight trip in Japanese travel planning.

examples.japanese: {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a hot spring for an overnight trip.

examples.japanese: {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An overnight company trip is being planned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧{一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a one-night Kyoto trip plan.

examples.japanese: {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{二泊三日|にはくみっか}→二泊三日：16274_nihakumikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: One night isn't enough time, so let's make it two nights.

notes:
An extremely common expression in Japanese travel culture. Japan's domestic travel industry structures packages and plans around this counting system: ○泊○日 (○ nights ○ days). The pattern extends naturally: 二泊三日 (2 nights 3 days), 三泊四日, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: overnight trip
- {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧: overnight plan/package
- {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: for one night (duration)
- {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}{二食付|にしょくつ}き: one night with two meals included

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{二泊三日|にはくみっか}→二泊三日：16274_nihakumikka⟧: two nights three days
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧: day trip (no overnight stay)
- ⟦{連泊|れんぱく}→連泊：07049_renpaku⟧: consecutive nights' stay
